newsitem.title: UK: BZW to swap equity research with U.S. firm - paper.
newsitem.headline: BZW to swap equity research with U.S. firm - paper.

text.p: BZW, the investment banking arm of Barclays, is to swap equity research with U.S. retail broking house Smith Barney in an attempt to reinforce its knowledge of the United States, the Financial Times reported on Wednesday.
The move is to compensate for its lack of equity research and sales in the U.S. domestic market according to the newspaper.

It said research is to be swapped electronically and analysts at each firm would be able to contact counterparts. The two firms have chosen 14 sectors in which analysts are to be asked to foster working relationships.
